_doc: Ground fires (ADR-0057, GroundFire): what a shattered molotov leaves burning. A fire is transient (never saved: it is out long before anyone could save and reload into it). radius / height: the burning disc (m) and how high its flames reach; duration: seconds it burns at full strength, then fade: seconds the flames shrink and the light dims while it still burns (its damage scales down with it); linger: seconds the smoke and the scorch stay after it is out. tick: seconds between damage steps; dps: damage per second to the Hollowed and wildlife standing in it (DamageInfo type fire, cause fire), player_dps to a player. structure_dps: damage per second to flammable structures (StructureDef.flammable; their damage_mult.fire applies) within radius + structure_reach, every structure_tick seconds. ignite_noise: the whoomp it lights with, crackle_noise every crackle_every seconds after (Stimuli kind 'fire', loudness in metres: the Hollowed come to look). light: the flames' omni light; sight_range / sight_energy: how it lights up whoever stands near it for the Hollowed's eyes (Stimuli.register_light). flames: flame columns scattered over the disc, flame_size their height (m).
